Definition: to resprout, i.e. propagate by shoots; figuratively, to be perpetual
BiblicalUsage: Nun means to resprout, to send out shoots, and so to continue, to be perpetual. Psalm 72:17 promises that the king's name shall be continued as long as the sun, and all nations shall call him blessed.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the name that lasts is the one God keeps growing, and the king of Psalm 72 points past himself to the one whose name never fades.
